messages.content:
Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000754": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000669" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays; the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC window no longer applies.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000656" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC; the previous weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC slot is retired.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000654" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000644" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000564": As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000497": As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000319" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000284" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000216" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
Existing entity names: ledger service, reporting service, the bus, product catalog, job scheduler, Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team, Cinder, feature-flags, webhook dispatcher, auth gateway, authentication gateway, Postgres 14
